name: HTML & CSS
description: I build pages with semantic HTML, navigation, images, and layouts. I have also used Bootstrap for catalogs and components.
example: On this portfolio, HTML gives each page its structure and CSS controls the layout, colors, and responsive design.

name: JavaScript
description: I use arrays, objects, functions, events, and form input to make pages respond to people.
example: The project filters on this page use click events to show matching cards. My maze project uses JavaScript to animate a search.

name: JSON
description: I have loaded and displayed movie data, people data, game questions, images, and other page content from JSON.
example: These skill descriptions come from learning.json. In my Jeopardy hub, JSON configuration supplies the available game and board choices.

name: React
description: I am learning React with Vite in ISU’s 3190 web development class, starting with reusable components and props.
example: In Activity 09, App.jsx passes a picture, name, salary, marital status, and address into reusable UserCard components built with React-Bootstrap.
